model: Straight-path full interval model with source armor fields, thin-part and reactive geometric gates, and normalized source KE range-carry budget.
conditions: Pristine authored pose. Armor-stack traversal ends after final armor layer before first bound inner part; no post-armor cabin-air charge.
probability_law: CE: uniform shot-level penetration dispersion threshold and independent ricochet survival. KE with source range curve:16-step monotonic initial-penetration threshold search, preserving layer loss and equivalent range.
unknowns: NaN for missing mapped material, missing solid exit, extra disjoint interval before protected target. Source binding part=-1 explicitly excluded. Background and no protected target have separate masks, not probability zero.
simplifications: Additive layer costs instead of iterative projectile carry/stability/breakup
No trajectory changes after ricochet: ricochet counts as straight-path penetration failure
ERA/composite response uses only loaded scalar qualities and geometry; activation, destruction and dynamic directional response omitted
No cumulative fuse/deviation/precharge state; ordinary M830 main-charge approximation
No fragments, blast, pressure, lethal damage, crew health depletion or repeat-hit state
Nonpositive/disabled armor uses declared source field branch; no game runtime overrides
performance_scope: Warm prepared geometry and GPU context; new numerical penetration value each request, no cached probability/image results. 434x137 true samples/view, not 2K true-ray sampling. Local HTTP + all PNG decode is measured; browser paint is separately user-visible, not benchmarked here.
geometry_model: All inward intervals retained. Nearest next distinct crossing must be outward for solid exit; shared triangle clustering10micrometers.
scope_of_correction: All separated intervals retained instead of one interval/node
Source material family provenance preserved; NERA quality fields not replaced with guessed RHAe
Thin-part KE gate and reactive class geometric bypass retained
KE available penetration propagated across layers using full21-point source range profile
CE inter-layer gaps retained, post-armor interior gap removed to match requested penetration endpoint
remaining_unverified: Full NERA-induced projectile precession/yaw/stability and integrity changes
ERA activation/destruction and runtime damage state
Exact whole-scene float32 transform/edge identity parity
Game probability calibration and random-state/correlation assumptions

material_response_flags.1: Source NERA family; full angular/dynamic response unvalidated

hatch: NERA/ERA source regions get light diagonal hatching. Numeric colors are conditional estimates; material/ray coverage is not a validation confidence.
